name: family-tasks
description: Скрипты для локальной разработки; у web/, mobile/, server/, notifier/, scheduler/, realtime/ и media/ свои package.json

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix notifier install && npm --prefix scheduler install && npm --prefix realtime install && npm --prefix media install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait db mailpit
scripts.dev:stop: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop db mailpit
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix notifier test && npm --prefix scheduler test && npm --prefix realtime test && npm --prefix media test && npm --prefix web test && npm --prefix mobile test
